title: Is Olive Oil A Natural Ozempic? What The GLP-1 Science Says
seoTitle: Is Olive Oil a Natural Ozempic? What the Science Says
excerpt: Bryan Johnson calls olive oil a natural Ozempic. The comparison points at real biology: a fullness hormone called GLP-1, three routes food reaches it, and trial numbers worth seeing side by side.
seoDescription: Bryan Johnson calls olive oil a natural Ozempic. How the drug works, how olive oil touches the same fullness hormone, and what the trials measured.
